full_judgment:
Mr. Md. Ataur Rahman Khan J.:- Rule was issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why the the impugned order contained in Memo No. Prasia/5P/ 16 Bidda-Chotto/2009/913/2 dated 15.7.2013 passed by respondent No.3 on behalf of respondent No.2 (Annexure-L) shall bot be declared to have been passed without lawful authority and is of no legal effect. 

	2. Short facts necessary for disposal of the Rule, is that, the petitioner's Grand Father Abdur Rahman Munsi was very kind hearted man and in order to enhance education in his local area the petitioner's grand father by Registered deed gifted a piece of land of .24 decimals to the Alexander Model Government Primary School on 12.08.1935. The gift deed was properly executed through registration with the Sub-Registry Office of Ramgati, Noakhali. The certified copy of the said registered deed of Gift dated 12.08.1935 is annexed marked as Annexure-A. 

	3. There is a proggapon issued by respondent No.2 vide Memo No.38.008.035.00.007.2012.688 dated 15.11.2012 where it has been stated that the Managing Committee of any primary school must be consisting of a member of Land-giver (if any) of the school as a Donor Member and the successors of the land giver will decide who will be the Donor Member of the School Managing Committee or the Upazila Parisad will decide any one of the successors as the member of the Managing Committee. The copy of the Proggapan dated 15.11.12 marked as Annexure-B. 

	4. The Chairman of Upazila Parisad respondent No.6 by letter No.00.512.80.00.05.0200- 41 dated 08.04.2013 nominated the petitioner as the Donor member of the Managing Committee as the petitioner is the successor of the land giver. 

	The heirs of the late Abdur Rahman Munsi have no objection to the nomination of the petitioner to be the Managing Committee of the Alexander Model Government Primary School. 

	5. The Chairman of Upazila Parisad respondent No.6 subsequently again by letter No.00.522.00.00.05.02.2013-47 dated 23.04.2013 confirmed that the petitoner's grand father Abdur Rahman Munsi by properly executed registered deed of gift, gifted the said piece of land to the Alexander Model Government Primary School on 12.08.1935 and as the petitioner is the grand son of the land giver, he is the appropriate person to be nominated as the Donor Member of the Managing Committee of the Alexander Model Government Primary School. 

	6. The Upazila Education Officer, Ramgati, Lakshmipur, the respondent No.5 by letter No.12/04 dated 28.04.2013 directed the Headmaster of the Alexander Model Government Primary School to form a Managing Committee as soon as possible. 

	7. The Headmaster of the Alexander Model Government Primary. School respondent No.10 by letter dated 18.04.2013 requested the Assistant Commissioner (Land), the respondent No.9, to identify the original status of the land which was gifted by petitioner's grand father. 

	8. The Surveyor of the Upazilla Land Office, Ramgati, Lakshmipur, submitted a report dated 25.04.2013 regarding the land where the land is found as Khas land. In the report it has been stated that the gifted land of the petitioner's grand father was never a private property according to the record. 

	9. The Assistant Commissioner (Land), Ramgati, Lakshmipur, the respondent No.9, agreed with the report submitted by the surveyor and sent the report to the Alexander Model Government Primary School authority by letter vide Memo No.00.522.009.00.00.001.2013-83 dated 28.04.2013. 

	10. The Headmaster of the Alexander Model Government Primary School issued a letter dated 29.04.2013 where it requested guideline from the Upazilla Sikha Officer regarding the Donor Member as the land is khas land.

	Subsequently, the Upazilla Education Officer, respondent No.5 sent a letter to District Primary Education Officer, the respondent No.4 dated 15.05.2013 for the guideline regarding formation of Managing Committee of Alexander Model Government Primary School. 

	11. Thereafter, the District Primary Education Officer, the respondent No.4 sent a letter vide Memo No.DPU/Lokhi/S.M.C./ 2013/1036 dated 23.06.2013 to the Director General of the Primary Education Odhidaptar, respondent No.2 and requested guideline regarding formation of Committee. 

	12. Suddenly, the respondent No.3 on behalf of the respondent No.2 issued a letter vide Memo No. Prasia/5P/16Bidda-Chotto/2009/913 dated 15.7.2013 and stated that there is no scope to include any member of land-giver in the Managing Committee of Alexander Model Government Primary School as the land is khas land and therefore the gift by the petitioner's grand father was not a valid one. 

	13. Previously there was dispute between Alexander Model Government Primary School and Alexander Pilot High School. A civil case was filed by the Alexander Pilot School bearing No.59/2000. On that occasion the Headmaster of Alexander Model Government Primary School by the written statement admitted that the land was given by the petitioner's grand-father. 

	14. The Assistant Commissioner (Land) is not the authority to ascertain title of the said land which was gifted by the grand father of the petitioner to the Alexander Model Government Primary School. 

	15. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the order dated 15.7.2013, the petitioner preferred this Writ Petition before this Court and obtained Rule and operation of the decision of the impugned order contained in Memo No.Prasid5P/16/Bidda-/Chotto/2009/913/2 dated 15.7.2013 passed by respondent No.3 on behalf of the respondent No.2 (Annexure-L) was stayed. 

	16. Mr. A.Y. Mashiuzzaman along with Mr. M.G. Mahmud (Shaheen), the learned Advocates appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that the impugned order have been issued without considering the real circumstances of the School and real facts. The impugned order passed by the respondents have been issued in violation of the Principles of Natural Justice as such the impugned order is liable to be declared to have been passed without lawful authority and is of no legal effect. They have further submitted that the Assistant Commissioner (Land) is not the authority to ascertain the title of the land which was gifted by the grand father of the petitioner to the Alexander Model Government Primary School. They have further submitted that grand father of the petitioner late Abdur Rahman Munshi gifted .24 decimals of land in favour of the Alexander Model Government Primary School on 12.08.1935, which was also admitted by the School authority in the written statement filed in Title Suit No.59 of 2000, in view of such admitted fact, the impugned order is absolutely malafide, arbitrary and without jurisdiction. They have further submitted that Chairman of Upazilla Parisad respondent No.6 by letter No.00.512.80.00.05.0200.41 dated 08.01.2013 nominated the petitioner as the Donor Member of the Managing Committee as the petitioner as the successor of the land giver. They, have further 
submitted that the Chairman of Upazila Parisad respondent No.6 subsequently again by letter No.00.522.00.00.05.02.2013-47 dated 23.04.2013 confirmed that the petitioner's grand father Abdur Rahman Munsi by properly executed registered deed of gift, gifted the said piece of land to the Alexander Model Government Primary School on 12.08.1935 and the petitioner is grand son of the land giver, he is the appropriate person to be nominated as the Donor Member of the Managing Committee of the Alexander Model Government Primary School. They have lastly submitted that the respondent No.2 in connivance with the Head master and others issued this impugned order which is not just and sustainable in law. Accordingly, they prayed that the present Rule may be made absolute for ends of justice. 

	17. Mr. Amit Talukder, learned Deputy Attorney General along with Mr. Md. Jahangir Alam, Assistant Attorney General appearing on behalf of the respondents submits that .24 decimals of land in plot No.7619/8297 in JL No.18 of Char Alexander Mouza Ramgai Upazilla under District Lakshmipur has been recorded in khas khatian No.1 of the Government and it was finally published in P.S. record of 1935 and in remarks column of the khatian it was written as school. In S.A survey of 1960 also the said .24 decimals of land of plot No.7619/8297 was also recorded in khas khatian No.1 of the Government. They have further submitted that in this regard the grand father of the petitioner was not the owner of the said land. As per land record the school is situated as khas land and Government is the owner of the land. They have also submitted that the respondent No.3 legally and lawfully issued the impugned letter as per Nitimala dated 15.11.2012 and, as such the Rule is liable to be discharged. 

	18. Heard the learned Advocate of both sides, perused the supplementary affidavit filed by the petitioner and affidavit-in-opposition filed by the respondent No.4 and other necessary papers as available on record. It appears from the records that the petitioner's grand father Abdur Rahman Munsi for flourishing education in his locality gifted a piece of land of .24 decimals to the Alexander Model Government Primary School on 12.08.1935 by a registered deed. It also appears that the gift deed was properly executed and registration was done by the Sub-Registry Office of Ramgati, Noakhali. It also appears that the Chairman of Upazilla Parisad respondent No.6 by letter No.00.512 .80.00.05.0200-41 dated 08.04.2013 nominated the petitioner as Donor Member of the Managing Committee as the petitioner is the successor of the land giver. The Chairman of Upazilla Parisad respondent No.6 again by letter No.00.522.00.00.05.02.2013-47 dated 23.04.2013 confirmed that the petitioner's grand father Abdur Rahman Munsi by properly executed registered deed of gift in favour of the Alexander Model Government Primary School on 12.08.1935 and as the petitioner is the grand son of the land giver. The petitioner is legally entitled to be a Member of the School Managing Committee as a representative of land giver. 

	19. It also appears that the Surveyor of the Upazilla Land Officer, Ramgati, Lakshmipur in pursuance of Memo No.10 dated 18.04.2013 submitted a report dated 25.04.2013 to the Assistant Commissioner (Land), Ramgati, Laxmipur, wherein it is clearly stated that one Abdur Rahman Munsi son of late Rahim Uddin Patwary, Village-Char-Alexander, Mouza No.1 of Char-Alexander, in Khatian No.1 and dag No.8297 by a registered deed No.1459 dated 12.08.1935 gifted 0.24 acres of land in favour of the President of District School Board, Noakhali which was recorded as Char Alexander High School on 21.07.1996. It also appears that the gifted land was wrongly recorded in the Government khas Khatian and the petitioner's grand father Abdur Rahman Munsi filed N.H. Misc Case No.01/1933-34 and on the basis of N.H. Misc. Case No.01/1933-34 the said .24 acres of land was recorded in his name and gifted said .24 decimals of land to Char Alexander Primary School. 

	20. Considering the above facts and circumstances, we find that the respondent No.2 in connivance with the Head master of the Alexander Model Government Primary School have illegally issued the Memo No. Prasia/5P/16Bidda-Chotto/2009/913/2 dated 15.7.2013 corresponding to 1420 B.S. thereby it requires interference. In such circumstances, the petitioner is the appropriate person to be nominated as the Donor Member of the Managing Committee of the Alexander Model Government Primary School as mentioned above. 

	21. In the result, the Rule is made absolute without any order as to cost. 

	22. The respondents are directed to appoint the petitioner as Donor Member of the Alexander Model Government Primary School.

	23. Communicate the order at once. 

	End.
